name: Deep33
identity_check: Confirmed as the US-Israel deep-tech fund Deep33 (Deep33 Ventures), chaired by Lior Susan of Eclipse Ventures and led by Lior Prosor and Michael Broukhim, with offices in Tel Aviv, New York and Los Angeles (Globes, Quantum Insider). Not DeepDAO, not Deep Instinct, not Deepgram. Own website (deep33.com) was not fetched.
